title: Feature Request: MCP repo scope
body:
I'm experimenting with Claude Code + MCP Servers.

One thing that tripped me up is that the Claude project config appears to be scoped to whatever directory `claude` was run from, so if I run `claude mcp add` in one directory in a repo then move to another directory in the same repo, the `mcp` config is gone. This is a monorepo using `yarn` workspaces.

I would expect `project` scope to refer to the repository rather than the folder `claude` was run from.

Maybe there could be an explicit `repo` scope when managing MCP servers. I would imagine this would also be useful for other config that would be unexpectedly absent / different depending on the current working directory.

Thanks!
author: CiaranMn
